cards.title: Core idea
cards.body: The eJPT is INE's 48-hour, open-book, fully hands-on exam: 45 questions answered by attacking a lab network, 70 percent to pass. INE rebuilt it on 31 March 2026, moving from 35 to 45 questions with more web app and recon content.

cards.title: How it works
cards.body: Domains: Host and Network Penetration Testing 35 percent, Assessment Methodologies 25 percent, Host and Network Auditing 25 percent, Web Application Penetration Testing 15 percent. The course runs Modules 0 to 6 over a 10-week plan at 1.5 to 2 hours a day, using free videos and TryHackMe.

questions.q: How many questions and what pass mark?
questions.a: 45 questions, 70 percent to pass, over 48 hours.

questions.q: Which domain carries the most weight?
questions.a: Host and Network Penetration Testing at 35 percent.
Yes. It is open-book and fully hands-on.
